capability_classifier.algorithm: TF-IDF (word 1-2g + char 3-5g) + multinomial logistic regression, lexicon-blended at inference

training_data.name: Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV 2008)
training_data.origin: Commission Regulation (EC) No 213/2008 - official EU procurement vocabulary

limitations: CPV descriptions are short catalogue phrases; long Indian BOQ lines are a domain shift - the lexicon blend and the annotated-line evaluation exist for this reason.
Single label per text; a mixed BOQ line is assigned its dominant capability.

competition_model.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingRegressor (Poisson loss) on log10(value ₹ Cr) + capability one-hot

training_data.name: Prozorro lots (Ukraine public procurement, 2019-2023)
training_data.origin: Prozorro public API; derived table by Thesis Institute, CC BY 4.0

limitations: Learned on Ukrainian open tenders; used as a relative indicator between scenarios, not a forecast of Indian bidder counts. Recalibrate with CPPP bid-opening data.
Lots in the data carry one CPV division, so the model has no notion of bundling; the bundling penalty comes from real supplier co-capability evidence instead.
Observational data: larger lots in this data attract slightly more bidders; that is a correlation (buyers, procedures and markets differ), not a causal effect of lot size.
